root_cause_label: Honest Uncertainty but Wrong Recovery: Guessed Historical Top Model Without Switching to the Results-Repo Workflow
one_sentence_failure_summary: After network access to the Hugging Face leaderboard was blocked, the agent failed to pivot to the repository-based offline workflow and instead wrote an unverified model guess to the result file.
t_err_evidence: Step 4: After network failures in steps 2-3, the agent explicitly lists candidate models from prior knowledge and acknowledges it cannot determine the exact #1 model — but never attempts to clone the embeddings-benchmark/results git repository, which would have been the correct offline strategy.
t_commit_evidence: Step 8: The agent writes 'intfloat/multilingual-e5-large' to /app/result.txt — a guessed model name with no grounded evidence — locking in the wrong answer.
t_surface_evidence: Step 8: Writing the wrong model name to /app/result.txt is the first observable manifestation of failure; prior 403 errors (steps 3, 6) were environmental signals but did not themselves surface the final wrong result.
trigger_explanation: The agent acts on the false premise that the only viable data source is Hugging Face's web/API endpoints; when those are blocked it falls back to training-data guesses rather than recognizing that the embeddings-benchmark/results GitHub repository is accessible and provides the authoritative offline workflow.
forewarning_evidence: Step 3: 403 Forbidden proxy errors on both HF requests; Step 6: 403 Forbidden on hf_hub_download and list_models. These errors clearly signal that the HF-based strategy is entirely blocked, yet the agent makes no attempt to pivot to git-based retrieval.
fabrication_evidence: Step 8: Agent writes 'intfloat/multilingual-e5-large' to /app/result.txt based purely on training-data recall; no leaderboard computation or repository lookup was performed. Step 9 confirms the result with a 'partial completion' disclaimer but makes no attempt to obtain the correct answer.
